book.title: Book a space
book.noSpaces: No spaces are open for booking yet.
book.confirmWaitlist: This slot is full. Join the waitlist?
book.membershipTypeNotAllowed: This space is reserved for other membership types. Yours does not include it — ask the club if you want to change it.
book.noMembershipType: This space is reserved for certain membership types and your record has none assigned. Ask the club to assign you one.
book.price: This booking costs {price} before tax; the receipt will show the final amount.
book.priceOnPromotion: If a place frees up you are booked automatically and charged {price} before tax; the receipt will show the final amount.
book.refundPolicy: If you cancel before paying, the receipt is voided with the booking. If you cancel a booking already paid, the club has to return the amount; the club makes the refund directly.
book.heldOnPromotion: If a place frees up in time, we will hold it for you until you pay ({price} before tax); the receipt will show the final amount.
book.heldUntil: The booking is held until you pay: you have until {date} to pay it, or it will be released.
book.pendingToast: Booking held: pay the receipt to confirm it

my.title: My bookings
my.confirmCancelDescription: Your place is freed for another member. If you change your mind you will have to book it again.
my.payBy: Pay before {date} or the booking will be released.
my.pendingNotice: Your booking is held until you pay it.

spaces.title: Spaces
spaces.info: Spaces are the courts, rooms and pitches members can book. Each space has opening hours and its own slots; deactivate a space to stop taking bookings without deleting its history.
spaces.name: Name
spaces.priceHint: Before tax. Leave it empty, or 0, and the space is free — no receipt is raised.
spaces.noSpaces: No spaces yet. Create one to start taking bookings.
spaces.confirmDelete: Delete this space? Its slots and bookings will be removed. To stop taking bookings without deleting anything, deactivate it from Edit.
spaces.deleteAffected: {count, plural, one {# member has active bookings that will be cancelled and notified by email.} other {# members have active bookings that will be cancelled and notified by email.}}
spaces.hoursSlotsAffected: {count, plural, one {# upcoming slot falls outside the new hours and will be deleted.} other {# upcoming slots fall outside the new hours and will be deleted.}}
spaces.allowedTypesHint: With none ticked the space is open to every member. Tick types and only those members can book it.

slots.priceHint: Leave it empty to use the space's price. Enter 0 to make this slot free.
slots.repeatWeekdaysHint: With no selection, the picked date's weekday is used.
slots.pastTime: That time today has already passed.
slots.noSlots: No slots yet. Add slots on concrete dates members can book.
slots.confirmDelete: Delete this slot? Its bookings will be removed too. To stop taking bookings without deleting anything, use Deactivate.
slots.deleteAffected: {count, plural, one {# member has active bookings that will be cancelled and notified by email.} other {# members have active bookings that will be cancelled and notified by email.}}

adminBookings.confirmCancel: Cancel this booking? A waitlisted member will be promoted.
adminBookings.expired: Cancelled for not paying in time
adminBookings.confirmWithoutPaymentDescription: The booking is confirmed without charging and its receipt is voided. It is recorded in the history.

settings.title: Bookings
settings.enabledDesc: Let members reserve time on shared spaces.
settings.invalidNumber: Enter a whole number between {min} and {max}.
settings.waitlistDesc: When a slot is full, let members join a waitlist and be promoted automatically.

legacy.tooltip: This space uses the earlier flow: bookings are confirmed at once and the receipt is collected afterwards. You can move it to the new flow from its page, and new bookings will then be held until paid.

payment.legacyNotice: This space confirms bookings at once and the receipt is collected afterwards. If you move it to the new flow, paid bookings will be held until paid. Bookings already made do not change.
payment.switchDescription: From now on, a paid booking is held until paid and cancelled if it is not paid in time. Bookings already made do not change. This cannot be undone.
payment.switchPending: On saving, the space moves to the pay-to-confirm flow. Choose the payment methods it accepts.
payment.methodsHint: How a member may pay for a paid booking. A space with a price cannot be saved without at least one.
payment.emailsOff: A paid space cancels bookings not paid in time, so these emails must be on first: {templates}.
payment.deadlineHint: Every pending booking must be paid before its slot starts, with the margin the club sets in Settings › Payments. Automatic cancellation can bring that deadline forward.
payment.autoCancelOff: No, only when the margin before the slot is reached
payment.autoCancelStartsNow: Once on, bookings already pending get the deadline from now (if it is sooner than theirs) and their members are told.
